lyrics:
[Intro: slow synth chords, soft pulse, radio tuning]

[Verse 1: plain kind male voice]
It's three, and the ceiling's all you've read

You think there's no one else at home

[Chorus: chords rise, strings, steady beat]
This is a signal for the sleepless
For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
You are not the only light

Stay. Stay.

[Verse 2: voice a little fuller]

A baker, a driver, a man who can't dream
Windows lit like a second sky
Nobody knows the other's why

For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
You are not the only light
I can't fix it, I can't hold you
But I'm awake, and so are they
This is a signal for the sleepless
Stay. Stay.

[Bridge: beat drops out, piano and voice]
Morning isn't far
It never has been

For the ones still up tonight
Look out, look out across the rooftops
